#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int check(const vector<char>& tgt, const vector<char>& src) {
    int n = tgt.size();
    if (src.size() != n) return 0;

    char xDig = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (src[i] == 'X') {
            if (xDig == 0) {
                xDig = tgt[i];
            } else {
                if (tgt[i] != xDig) return 0;
            }
        }
    }

    if (tgt[0] == '0') return 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (src[i] != '_' && src[i] != 'X' && tgt[i] != src[i]) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

        string sOG;
        cin >> sOG;
        int n = sOG.size();

            if (sOG[0] == '0' || sOG[0] == '_' || sOG[0] == 'X')
                cout << 1 << "\n";
            else
                cout << 0 << "\n";
            continue;
        }

        int totalWays = 0;

        // Check for "00" pattern

            vector<char> s(sOG.begin(), sOG.end());
            bool invalid = (s[n - 1] != '_' && s[n - 1] != 'X' && s[n - 1] != '0');
            invalid |= (s[n - 2] != '_' && s[n - 2] != 'X' && s[n - 2] != '0');

            if (!invalid) {
                if (s[n - 1] == 'X' || s[n - 2] == 'X') {
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                        if (s[i] == 'X') s[i] = '0';
                }
                s[n - 1] = '0';
                s[n - 2] = '0';

                totalWays += check(vector<char>(sOG.begin(), sOG.end()), s);
                for (int num = 0; num < 1000000; num++) {
                    string numStr = to_string(num) + "00";
                    vector<char> tgt(numStr.begin(), numStr.end());
                    totalWays += check(tgt, s);
                }
            }
        }

        // Check for "25" pattern
        {
            vector<char> s(sOG.begin(), sOG.end());
            bool invalid = (s[n - 1] != '_' && s[n - 1] != 'X' && s[n - 1] != '5');

            invalid |= (s[n - 1] == 'X' && s[n - 2] == 'X');

                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                        if (s[i] == 'X') s[i] = '5';
                } else if (s[n - 2] == 'X') {
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)

                }
                s[n - 1] = '5';

                    totalWays += check(tgt, s);
                }

        // Check for "50" pattern
        {

            invalid |= (s[n - 2] != '_' && s[n - 2] != 'X' && s[n - 2] != '5');
            invalid |= (s[n - 1] == 'X' && s[n - 2] == 'X');

            if (!invalid) {

        // Check for "75" pattern
        {
            vector<char> s(sOG.begin(), sOG.end());

            invalid |= (s[n - 2] != '_' && s[n - 2] != 'X' && s[n - 2] != '7');
